goal: Corrigir comparação preservada U32 nos três achados financeiros/proveniência, preservando demais N28.
actions: Comparabilidade exige mesmo installationId e projectId além de contexto/section/período/moeda/engine; não unir cortes de scopes diferentes. Não atribuir vazamento de leitura não demonstrado.
Exibir antes/depois de valor, moeda, unidade, evidenceState e completude nas linhas de alteração, inclusive100USD→100EUR e0↔null; nenhuma conversão FX inferida.

Separar mudança numérica de mudança de proveniência: comparar sourceRefs/version/incarnation/observedAt aplicáveis a valores/seções/projeções; não rotular corte inteiro unchanged quando fonte mudou. Não inventar variação financeira quando só fonte mudou.
Agenda projection.review é seam151/A07+132, não corrigir por edição de backend ou shared. Preserve agenda/reports fora do allowlist e forneça exatamente os blobs/patches U32 para132.

complete_findings.root_cause: comparableReviewSections checks section IDs/period and projection context currency, surface, engineVersion, period but omits installationId and projectId, although the public SfReviewDomainProjection context carries both.
complete_findings.causal_reproduction_static: Give UI49 two independently authorized preserved review values with the same section id/period, projection surface, currency, engineVersion and context period but different projection.context.installationId or projectId. comparableReviewSections returns true; UI49 labels them compatible and enables scalar diff. This does NOT prove the producer permits cross-tenant read; that requires a negative hosted recheck.
complete_findings.expected: Fail closed on distinct installation/project or require explicit authorized, prominently scoped cross-project semantics approved by contract; never silently treat unrelated tenant/project amounts as one comparable cut.
complete_findings.impact: False financial comparison across installation/project boundaries; risk of misleading decision even where each record is separately readable, with potential authority confusion.
complete_findings.recheck: After owner152 patch and 132 composition, have 150 execute U32/UI49 host-backed scenario with two source scopes, including same period/currency and denied second read. Assert incompatible and no joined diff, while same-scope reviews compare; obtain actual run, SHA, fixture identity and output.

complete_findings.category: financial value, currency, unit and evidence-state preservation
complete_findings.root_cause: preservedValueRows includes differences in unit/currency/evidenceState, but the compare table renders only String(value), without those changed dimensions.
complete_findings.causal_reproduction_static: Same review context/scope/period with one value id and number 100 in both cuts, but value.currency changes USD to EUR (or unit or evidenceState confirmed to estimated). Detection includes the row; UI49 displays '100' -> '100' without the cause, making a material financial/provenance change look like no numerical change.
complete_findings.expected: Show before/after currency, unit, evidenceState, and source completeness beside amounts, and preserve zero distinct from null; never infer FX.
complete_findings.impact: Finance reviewers cannot tell that identical numbers have incompatible units/currencies or differing confidence.
complete_findings.recheck: Hosted table/a11y oracle in 150: 100 USD→100 EUR, confirmed→estimated, 0→null and null→0; ensure labels and evidence state are visible in source-authorized table and comparison; inspect 132 integrated blob before closing.

complete_findings.category: provenance, source versions and authenticity of 'unchanged'
complete_findings.root_cause: preservedValueRows compares value/evidenceState/unit/currency only, not per-value sourceRefs and source version; changed() looks only at value rows, count and title, then displays 'unchanged', ignoring section and projection sourceRefs and their incarnation/version/observedAt.
complete_findings.causal_reproduction_static: Two preserved snapshots with same section id/title/count, same scalar value/evidenceState/unit/currency and period, but sourceRefs.version v7→v8 (or incarnation/observedAt changed) have zero preservedValueRows; changed() is false; UI49 shows 'unchanged' despite changed source ancestry.
complete_findings.expected: Independently classify source/provenance revision versus numerical change; expose before/after source version/incarnation and actual cut without inventing value changes. Keep unchanged scalar label only when scoped explicitly to scalar equality.
complete_findings.impact: Masks source freshness/revocation dependencies and misleads financial evidence review; historical confirmation must not be implied current.
complete_findings.recheck: Owner152 updates comparator and 150 validates same numbers+different sourceRefs/version/incarnation, identical sources, and denied/revoked historical case; 132 rechecks integrated exact blob, no final acceptance inferred.
